name: Argan Oil & Lavender Smooth and Serene Conditioner
ingredients_raw: Water, Cetearyl Alcohol, Behentrimonium Chloride (and) Dipropylene Glycol, Dimethicone (And) Amodimethicone (and) PEG-7 Propylheptyl Ether (and) Cetrimonium Chloride, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Perfume, L-Lysine Monohydrochloride, Argania Spinosa (Argan) Kernel Oil, Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Oil^, Acrylates/Beheneth-25 Methacrylate Copolymer, Lactic Acid, Disodium EDTA, Benzyl Alcohol, 1, 2-Hexanediol, Sodium Hydroxide, Citronellol, Coumarin, Limonene, Linalool. Plant Based Ingredients.
